title: The Book of Life
definition: The Book of Life is Scripture's image of God's secure knowledge of those who belong to Him and inherit eternal life.
summary: The Book of Life speaks of God's certain knowledge and secure record of those who belong to Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the Lamb whose people are recorded as His redeemed ones.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Book of Life is Scripture's picture of those who belong to God and have eternal life in Christ. It speaks of security, judgment, belonging, and final recognition before the Lord.

The image reminds believers that salvation is not hidden from God or uncertain to Him. He knows His own, keeps His own, and will publicly vindicate those written in the Lamb's book of life.

Jesus is the Lamb connected to this book. The hope of being named before God rests in Him, not in human reputation or religious achievement.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often fear being forgotten, unseen, or finally rejected. The Book of Life gives solemn warning to the unbelieving and deep comfort to those whose life is hidden with Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek assurance in belonging to Christ rather than being known by the world. Let this doctrine sober you, comfort you, and move you to call others to the Lamb who gives eternal life.
